archetypes.name: migration-parity
archetypes.rationale: Large sh-to-py port must preserve retired script contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python ports against the retired Bash behavior described in the plan. Focus on review phase detail timing windows, round-meta counts, run-summary usage errors, findings-view filtering, gc-run-logs guards, and status KVs. Call out behavior drift that is not covered by tests. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retirement-hygiene
archetypes.rationale: Deleted scripts and migrated manifest entries can leave stale call sites.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the deleted script paths, migrated-scripts.tsv entries, Makefile shards, docs, skills, and agent-lint allowlists. Verify active consumers call python/cli.py directly and no retired path reference survives outside the migration manifest. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: gantt-roundmeta
archetypes.rationale: Phase-detail Gantt and round-meta synthesis are regression-sensitive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect progress_report and review_phase_detail for timeout safety, dual timing-ledger windows, reviewer label attribution, cost windowing, and no-round behavior. Check that design and implement round-meta writers remain best-effort and preserve their schemas. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
